# Alerting and Detection Strategy (ADS) — Rule 100004

## Goal

What adversary behavior this detection is meant to catch. Name the ATT&CK technique(s).

## Categorization

- **ATT&CK technique(s):** `T1546.003` — Event Triggered Execution: Windows Management Instrumentation Event Subscription
- **Tactic(s) (v20):** Privilege Escalation, Persistence
- **Lab rule_id:** `100004`
- **Source Sigma rule:** `rules/sigma/T1546.003_wmi_event_subscription.yml` (derived from SigmaHQ sysmon_wmi_event_subscription.yml)

## Strategy Abstract

How the detection works, in plain language: which telemetry field(s), what condition, what it keys on.

## Technical Context

Event 20 always went to built-in 89501 (level 12), which shares the Event 20 parent rule (61648) with 100004 (level 8). Wazuh evaluated the higher-level sibling first, so 100004 never alerted on Event 20.

```xml
<rule id="100004" level="8">
    <if_sid>61647, 61648, 61649</if_sid>
    <description>T1546.003: WMI event subscription $(win.eventdata.eventType) $(win.eventdata.operation)</description>
    <mitre>
      <id>T1546.003</id>
    </mitre>
  </rule>
```

## Blind Spots and Assumptions

Where this detection fails or can be evaded.

## False Positives

What benign activity could trigger this, and what the baseline measurement actually showed. Reference the baseline manifest action if an FP was seen.

## Validation

- **Positive test:** Atomic T1546.003 #1 "Persistence via WMI Event Subscription - CommandLineEventConsumer" (GUID 3c64f177-28e2-49eb-a799-d767b24dd1e0). Result: detected Y, 3 lab runs. 100004 fired on Events 19 and 21 in every run. Latencies 1.448 s / 1.406 s / 1.208 s (Event 19).
- **Converter fidelity:** sigma_to_wazuh converted it (900005). Manual fixes: if_sid scoped to the Sysmon WMI base rules 61647, 61648 and 61649 (the generic list plus an eventID regex would also match event IDs 19, 20 and 21 from other channels, such as Windows Update's System event 19), and MITRE IDs. Lab conventions: rule ID, level 10 to 8.
- **Negative test:** the 5-run baseline FP cost.

## Priority / Response

Suggested alert level and a one-line analyst response.
